blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss.
Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers’ calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution . We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream’s running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46 % 46\% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 0.17 MB ( 0.01 % 0.01\% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.
blocks.zh:
训练后量化是将视觉变压器(ViTs)装入边缘计算和内存预算的标准途径,然而被量化的模型在分配转变下变得特别脆. 试验时间适应(TTA)处理这种没有标签的转变,但大多数现有方法与量化推论的限制不相一致。 常用的TTA方法通过回推法恢复精度,而无背丙方法往往仍然需要额外的前行通行证或参数更新产生的间接费用,而轻量级特征法或登录级方法只收回部分损失。
通过这些方法,一个能放大下降的量化特定失败模式并没有直接针对目标:在转变中,活化器占据了被冻结的量化器的校正范围不同,扭曲了它们的代码分布。 我们提出"量子-相通再调整"(QuAR),一种针对量子化的VITs定制的单通TTA方法,既不反射,也不更新任何模型参数. QuAR重新校正一个被冻结的量子输入时的活性, 在ImageNet-C和ViT-B上,QuAR以3-,4-,6-和8-位重量/活性精度在最先进的无背道口TTA方法中实现最高平均精度,在8位比特和3位比特上表现优于最强基线2.28 2.28分和4.00 4.00分,其中46%46分的低空和内存管理费只有0.17分0.17分(峰值推断内存0.01%0.01%). 分析和诊断将收益追溯到这些分数器的每道错配减少,这恢复了代码分布,基线留下不变或进一步扭曲. 一个单一的固定配置仍然在连续流、非i.d.标签转换、7个分配外套房和3个其他主干。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision transformers (ViTs) ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) are the backbone of many vision systems, but their compute and memory cost makes them impractical to run at full precision on edge devices. Post-training quantization (PTQ) ( Yuan et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) is a standard remedy. From a label-free calibration set it fixes weights and activation quantizers to low bit-widths with no retraining, so inference can better fit edge budgets. The deployed quantized model pays for that efficiency with rigidity, its quantizers frozen and its activation ranges tuned to the calibration distribution.
blocks.zh: 视向变压器(ViTs)(Dosovitskiy等,2021年)是许多视向系统的骨干,但其计算和内存成本使其在边缘设备上完全精确运行不切实际. 训练后定量法(PTQ)(袁克等,2022;吴克等,2024)是一种标准补救措施. 从无标签的校正设置中,它固定了重量并激活了四分位器到没有再培训的低位宽,因此推论可以更好地适应边缘预算. 所部署的量子化模型以刚性支付效率,其量子被冻结,活化范围被调整到校正分布。

blocks.en: This rigidity becomes a liability at test time. When the input distribution shifts under corruption or domain change, the calibrated activation ranges no longer match it, causing a substantial accuracy drop. The drop is amplified by quantization, 1.7 × 1.7\times at W3A3 (Appendix P ), leaving the unadapted model at 28.4 28.4 top-1 where full precision holds 55.6 55.6 (Figure 1 a; W n n A m m denotes n n -bit weights and m m -bit activations). The cause is concrete. Under shift, the per-channel activation statistics entering the quantizers drift from their calibration values (Figure 2 a). Those quantizers are frozen and per-tensor, so they cannot follow that drift. They map the activations onto a part of their range they were never calibrated for, distorting their code distribution : the discrete levels the activations are mapped to. These per-interface distortions accumulate along the frozen path to the logits, where they meet a decision margin the shift has already narrowed. The quantization error does not grow under shift, but the same error now flips more labels. It flips more of them the coarser the step, which is why quantization amplifies the drop (Section 3.5 ). A fifth of the channels at those quantizers forfeit at least half a bit of code resolution to that drift (Figure 2 b). Recovering accuracy therefore requires correcting this intermediate, quantizer-level mismatch, not only the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 这种僵硬性在试验时成为一项负债. 当输入分布在腐败或域变下发生转移时,被校正的活化范围不再与之相匹配,导致大量精度下降. 投放被分量放大,在W3A3(Appendix P)上为1.7×1.7\times,将未适应的型号留在了28.4 28.4上到1,其中全精度能持有55.6 55.6 (图1a;Wnn A m 表示n-位重和m-位活化). 原因是具体的。 在转动下,进入分数器的每道活化统计会从它们的校正值上漂移出(图2 a). 这些分数器被冷冻和每分分数,所以它们不能跟随这种漂移. 他们将活化图映射到他们范围的一部分, 他们从未被校准过, 扭曲了他们的代码分布: 活化图的离散级别。 这些一面扭曲沿通向对数的被冻结的路径积累,在这种路径中,变化已经缩小了,它们达到一个决定幅度。 量化错误不会在转向下增大,但同样的错误现在翻转了更多的标签. 它能翻转更多的人,使步子更平缓,这就是量化放大倒数的原因(第3.5节)。 这些分解器的五分之一的信道至少丧失了该漂移的半分码分辨率(图2b)。 因此,要恢复准确性,就需要纠正这种中间体 -- -- 量子级 -- -- 的不匹配,而不仅仅是最后的预测。

(a) ViT-B accuracy on ImageNet-C by precision: unadapted accuracy falls from 55.6 55.6 to 28.4 28.4 at W3A3, while QuAR’s gain grows as precision drops, from + 3.8 +3.8 to over + 6 +6 at every quantized setting. (b) At the recalibrated quantizer inputs (W6A6), corruption drifts the code distribution off its source calibration; bars show the fraction removed (Wasserstein- 1 1 between code histograms, Appendix P ). Only QuAR recovers much of that drift, ∼ 9 × {\sim}9\times the best baseline.

blocks.en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses distribution shift without labels ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Niu et al., 2023 ; Iwasawa and Matsuo, 2021 ) , and a recent line of work targets the quantized setting specifically ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . These methods recover accuracy, but quantized deployment asks for two things they do not provide. First is the cost. Entropy- or discrepancy-minimizing methods backpropagate through the network and update some or all of its parameters, while FOA ( Niu et al., 2024 ) , ZOA ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , and FOZO ( Wang and Wang, 2026 ) avoid backprop but still require extra forward passes per batch and update parameters at test time; each extra forward pass through a quantized graph and each model parameter update is what quantized deployment is designed to avoid. Second is placement. These methods act on either side of the quantizer inputs rather than at them, downstream at the feature or logit level and upstream on prompts or model parameters. We confirm this directly: the compared methods leave that code distribution unchanged or move it further from the source, whereas only ours recovers much of that drift (Figure 1 b).
blocks.zh: 试验时间适应(TTA)解决无标签的配送转移(Wang等,2021;Wang等,2022;Niu等,2023;Iwasawa和Matsuo等,2021;),近期一行工作专门针对具体分解设置(Deng等,2025). 这些方法可以恢复准确性,但量化的部署需要它们不提供的两样东西. 首先是成本。 Entropy-或相差最小化的方法通过网络进行回推进并更新其部分或全部参数,而FOA(Niu等,2024年),ZOA(Deng等,2025年),和FOZO(Wang和Wang,2026年)则避免后道,但仍需要每批额外前行通行证,并在测试时更新参数;每多前行通过一个被量化的图表,每个模型参数更新就是被量化的部署所要避免的. 二是安置. 这些方法在分量器输入物的两侧而不是在分量器输入物的两侧、下游的特征或登录层以及上游的导出或模型参数上发挥作用。 我们直接证实这一点:比较方法使代码分布保持不变或从源头更进一步移动,而只有我们恢复了大部分漂移(图1b)。

blocks.en: We argue that for quantized ViTs the right intervention is not to re-optimize the model but to recalibrate its activations back toward the statistics the quantizers were calibrated on. We introduce Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass , quantization-native TTA method built from parameter-free affine recalibrations, each applied at the input to a frozen quantizer. The local branch, QuAR’s quantizer-level core, acts at every intermediate activation interface in the late blocks, mapping the running per-channel mean and standard deviation of the test stream back toward the source calibration statistics. The global branch, a complementary correction, applies the same recalibration to the CLS representation at the head input. Both branches use source-initialized running target moments, perform no backpropagation, update no model parameters, and store no past samples; the method adds a single multiply–add per recalibrated activation inside one forward pass.
blocks.zh: 我们提出,为了量化 ViTs的正确干预并不是重新优化模型,而是重新调整其活化度,回到被校正的量子的统计上。 我们引入了"量子-相通再调整"(QuAR),一种由无参数的芳香再调整而成的单通,量子化-内生的TTA方法,每入入一被冻结的量子时分别应用. 本地分支,QuAR的四分仪级核心,在后方块的每一个中间活化界面上作用,绘制测试流回向源校正统计的每道运行平均值和标准偏差图. 全球分支作为补充的更正,对CLS在头部输入中的表示适用了同样的再调整. 两个分支都使用源初始化的运行目标瞬间,不进行回向传播,不更新模型参数,不存储过去样本;方法在一出前行通道内每一次调整活化增加一乘-加.

blocks.en: On ImageNet-C with quantized ViT-B, QuAR attains the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at every evaluated precision, W3A3, W4A4, W6A6 and W8A8, ahead of the strongest baseline by + 2.28 +2.28 at W8A8 and + 4.00 +4.00 at W3A3, at one forward pass and no parameter updates, 46 % 46\% less latency than ZOA and FOZO (Section 4.1 ). One fixed configuration keeps that lead on long-term continual streams, non-i.i.d. online label shift, seven further out-of-distribution benchmarks (ImageNet-R/Sketch/ C ¯ \overline{\mathrm{C}} /3DCC, CIFAR-10/100-C, and DomainNet-126), and three other backbones, the transformers DeiT-B and ViT-S, and a convolutional ResNet-50 (Sections 4.2 and 4.3 ). QuAR is also the most accurate method that fits an 8 8 GB Jetson Orin Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) at batch 64 64 , where the backprop-based methods run out of memory (Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 在ImageNet-C上,经过定量的ViT-B,QuAR在每一次评估的精度中,在最先进的无背道口TTA方法中,达到最高平均精度,W3A3、W4A4、W6A6和W8A8,比最强基线先于W8A8+2.28和W3A3+ 4.00+4.00,在一次前行和无参数更新时,比ZOA和FOZO低46%的46-%(第4.1节)。 一个固定的配置将铅保留在长期持续流上,非i.i.d.在线标签转换,另外七个分配外基准(ImageNet-R/Sketch/C'\overline\mathrm{C}/3DCC、CIFAR-10/100-C和DomainNet-126),以及另外三个主干,即变压器DeiT-B和Vit-S,以及一个革命性的ResNet-50(第4.2和4.3节)。 QuAR也是最准确的方法,它符合第6464批中8GB Jetson Orin Nano (NVIDIA, 2026),其中以后推为主的方法耗尽了内存(第4.6节).

blocks.en: We make the following contributions: • We propose QuAR, a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that recalibrates activations at frozen quantizer inputs, targeting the distortion of their code distribution , a quantization-specific failure mode that existing TTA does not directly address. • We trace the gain to a per-channel mismatch at the quantizer inputs, using a mismatch measurement, a precision sweep and a placement ablation. • We give a first-order account linking activation-moment drift, frozen-grid code resolution, and margin-sensitive prediction changes, and measure the quantities the account depends on.
blocks.zh: • 我们作出以下贡献: 我们提出QuAR,一种针对被分解的ViTs的单通TTA方法,在被冻结的Quantizer输入时重分解活性,针对的是其代码分配的扭曲性,这是现有的TTA没有直接处理的量化特定故障模式. ^ 我们利用不匹配的测量、精密的扫描和安放减速器,将收益追踪到每道输入量的不匹配。 我们给出一个第一顺序的账户, 连接激活-运动漂移, 冻结-网格代码分辨率, 和差值敏感的预测变化, 并测量账户所依赖的数量。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses a trained ViT to low-bit weights and activations from a small calibration set, with no retraining. PTQ4ViT ( Yuan et al., 2022 ) introduces twin uniform quantizers for the asymmetric post-Softmax and post-GELU activations, and AdaLog ( Wu et al., 2024 ) uses an adaptive logarithmic quantizer for those two activations at very low bit-widths, while the remaining linear-layer activations stay uniformly quantized. In either case each activation quantizer is frozen after calibration, its per-tensor range tuned to the source activation distribution. A test-time shift makes the per-channel activations occupy that calibrated range differently and distorts the quantizer’s code distribution, a quantization-specific failure that feature- or logit-level adaptation does not directly address. We take such a PTQ-quantized ViT as the fixed deployment artifact and adapt only its activation statistics at test time; the quantizers and weights are never modified.
blocks.zh: 训练后量子化(PTQ)将训练有素的VIT压缩为低位重量并从一个小的校正集活化,没有再训练. PTQ4ViT (Yuan等, 2022年)为不对称的后Softmax和后GELU活化引入了双相相等分量器,而AdaLog (Wu等, 2024年)则在非常低的位-wids对这两种活化使用适应性对数等分量器,而所剩线性层活化则保持了相等分量. 无论是哪种情况,每个活化量子在被校正后被冻结,其每发分数范围都调整到源活化分布. 测试时间的转变使每个通道的活化物占据了不同的校正范围并扭曲了四分位器的代码分布,即特性或日志级的适应不直接解决的量化特定故障. 我们把这种PTQ量化的VIT当作固定的部署文物,只在测试时调整它的活性统计;量子和重量从未被修改.

blocks.en:
Fully test-time adaptation updates a source model online from unlabeled test data. TENT ( Wang et al., 2021 ) minimizes prediction entropy through normalization-layer affine parameters, and CoTTA ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , EATA ( Niu et al., 2022 ) , and SAR ( Niu et al., 2023 ) stabilize this for continual and wild streams; T3A ( Iwasawa and Matsuo, 2021 ) is backprop-free, adjusting a non-parametric classifier from an online support set. A related line aligns intermediate activations or features to source statistics. ActMAD ( Mirza et al., 2023 ) is a test-time training method that matches per-channel, location-aware activation means and variances across several convolutional layers by backpropagating the matching loss and updating all parameters; TTT++ ( Liu et al., 2021 ) aligns feature moments through an auxiliary self-supervised objective; and LAME ( Boudiaf et al., 2022 ) adjusts output label assignments rather than activations. PEA ( Ma et al., 2026 ) aligns each transformer block’s output with a full-covariance whitening–coloring transform, which needs a second forward pass, more tokens than channels to estimate, and a dense full-precision matrix per block, recomputed each batch. These methods are full-precision and mostly rely on backpropagation and parameter updates that are costly or ill-defined once the model is quantized.
The recent Adaptive Quantile Recalibration ( Mehrbod et al., 2026 ) also recalibrates internal pre-activations in full precision, aligning channel-wise distributions with quantile transforms; its published ViT setting uses large batches, and we compare against that paper-default configuration
in Appendix J . QuAR instead matches per-channel mean and variance in closed form at the frozen quantizer of a low-bit ViT and at small batch sizes: a single-forward, parameter-update-free shift toward source statistics, requiring none of the gradients or full-network updates that make such test-time training infeasible on a quantized model. The Local-only ablation (Table 1 ) is itself a closed-form source-statistic activation-matching baseline at these interfaces.
blocks.zh:
完全测试时间适应从无标签测试数据在线更新一个源模型. TENT(Wang等,2021年)通过常态层等同源参数将预测 en最小化,而COTTA(Wang等,2022年),EATA(Niu等,2022年),SAR(Niu等,2023年)稳定为持续和野生溪流;T3A(Iwasawa和Matsuo,2021年)为回丙分流,从在线支持集中调整出一个非参数分类器. 一个相相通的行将中间活化或特性与源统计相协调. ActMAD(Mirza等,2023年)是一种测试时间训练方法,通过反向宣传匹配损失并更新所有参数来匹配每个通道,位置感知活化手段和多个分层的差异; TT++ (Liu等,2021年)通过辅助自控目标对地物瞬间进行对接;而LAME(Boudiaf等,2022年)则会调整输出标签分配,而不是激活. blocks.en:
To avoid backpropagation, FOA ( Niu et al., 2024 ) optimizes a few input prompts with CMA-ES and additionally shifts activations toward source statistics, using two forward passes per step. FOZO ( Wang and Wang, 2026 ) estimates descent directions with SPSA-style perturbations. For the quantized setting, ZOA ( Deng et al., 2025 ) adapts the quantized model’s LayerNorm affine parameters with zeroth-order updates against a feature-discrepancy loss, leaving the quantizers themselves untouched, and NEO ( Murphy et al., 2026 ) recenters features by a cumulative mean at the classifier, which is backprop-free and single-forward.
FORGE ( Rehan et al., 2026 ) re-normalizes BN-folded convolution outputs
in integer-only CNNs for microcontrollers,
using the statistics associated with the folded BN affine. This addresses a different architecture and intervention site from ours: QuAR targets activation-quantizer inputs in LayerNorm-based PTQ ViTs and uses partial local matching where full matching over-corrects.
The affine form of our correction is that of normalization-statistics adaptation ( Schneider et al., 2020 ; Mirza et al., 2023 ) ; the difference is the site. Applied where those methods apply it, at the block outputs, the same affine recovers only about half the gain at every bit-width, whereas at the quantizer inputs it restores the code distribution and adds 1.8 1.8 to 3.1 3.1 points (Appendix P ). These methods avoid backpropagation, but their adaptation cost is often several times a plain forward pass, and none is aware of the frozen quantizer’s code distribution. Our method is backprop-free and single-forward, and recalibrates the activations entering each quantizer in closed form against frozen per-channel source statistics, adding one multiply and one add per recalibrated activation: the local branch at the intermediate block quantizers and the global branch at the input quantizer of the classification head.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Let f θ f_{\theta} be a ViT quantized by PTQ ( Yuan et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , with its weights and per-tensor activation quantizers fixed from a small calibration set drawn from the clean source distribution. Write a quantized activation as Q ⁡ ( x ) = s ⋅ ( clip ⁡ ( ⌊ x / s ⌉ + z , q min , q max ) − z ) Q(x)=s\cdot\big(\mathrm{clip}(\lfloor x/s\rceil+z,\,q_{\min},q_{\max})-z\big) , where the scale s s and zero-point z z are frozen at calibration time. The clean source distribution the quantizers were calibrated on induces, at each activation interface ℓ \ell , a per-channel source mean and standard deviation ( 𝝁 s ℓ , 𝝈 s ℓ ) (\bm{\mu}_{s}^{\ell},\bm{\sigma}_{s}^{\ell}) . At test time the inputs are shifted, so the per-channel statistics of the activations entering each quantizer drift away from ( 𝝁 s ℓ , 𝝈 s ℓ ) (\bm{\mu}_{s}^{\ell},\bm{\sigma}_{s}^{\ell}) ; the frozen ( s , z ) (s,z) then round a mismatched range, degrading accuracy. Because the activation quantizers are per-tensor, a per-channel range drift is invisible to the single ( s , z ) (s,z) pair yet still distorts the rounded values. An upstream LayerNorm does not control this drift either. LayerNorm normalizes each token across channels, whereas the drift that mis-ranges the quantizer is per channel across tokens, so the two act along different axes. Not every quantized interface sits directly after a normalization, with the scale drift concentrated at those without one and the mean drift everywhere (Appendix U ). Restoring the source per-channel moments before quantization restores the quantizer toward its source-calibrated operating point, its code distribution; Lemma U.1 makes this precise. Our goal is to undo this drift at the activation level , online, without touching θ \theta , s s , or z z , and without extra forward passes.

blocks.en: A complementary correction applies the same affine recalibration of Equation 1 to the final CLS representation h ∈ ℝ C h\in\mathbb{R}^{C} at the input to the classification head, using CLS-specific source and running target moments, but at full strength. It can match fully, where the local branch matches only partially, for a positional reason. The CLS representation is terminal , consumed only by the frozen, source-trained head, so a full match aligns the head input with the source feature distribution it was trained on, and has nothing downstream to distort. A local interface instead feeds the rest of the network, where forcing activations all the way to source risks over-writing test-distribution structure that downstream blocks may use, so a partial match restores the quantizer’s calibrated range while retaining more of that structure. The full match corrects the residual shift at the head input and, like the local branch, does so in closed form against source statistics.

By default we use a forgetting-free cumulative estimate, α t = 1 / ( n ℓ + 1 ) \alpha_{t}=1/(n_{\ell}+1) over the n ℓ n_{\ell} batches seen, the source moments counting as one pseudo-batch, so all test batches weigh equally; moments from one batch alone are noisier and class-dependent, while moments converged over an extra pass change little (Appendix C ; Table 14 ). The local branch, whose output feeds the rest of the network, corrects before it updates, so it uses only the preceding batches and never normalizes a batch by its own statistics; the global branch, where a moment error has nothing downstream to compound it, updates first and so adapts from the first batch of a domain. Neither rate is tuned per setting. Algorithm 1 summarizes the procedure.

blocks.en: 3.4 Test-time cost
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 试验时间费用

blocks.en: QuAR costs a single forward pass per batch, zero test-time-updated model or quantizer parameters , and no stored past samples . Its only state is about 170 170 KB (0.01% of peak memory) of running target moments (Appendix Q ); it is backprop-free and adds a multiply–add per recalibrated activation. One forward pass suffices because each correction depends only on what passes through its own interface. The target is fixed, since calibration gives the source moments, and the input-side statistics are the running moments of the very activations the hook sees. The hook therefore corrects the activation and updates the moments inside the ordinary forward, at any depth, with nothing to evaluate at the output and no search direction. This lets QuAR act before the intermediate quantizers in a single pass. FOA, ZOA and FOZO instead adjust a few parameters against a loss that requires running the network on the candidates, and their derivative-free estimates take two such runs in the cheapest configuration each publishes; NEO and T3A are single-forward because they too are closed-form, but act only at the head. The source statistics ( 𝝁 s , 𝝈 s ) (\bm{\mu}_{s},\bm{\sigma}_{s}) add nothing at test time. A forward hook accumulates them once, offline, over unlabeled clean source images, and they ship with the model. PTQ calibration already presumes that access (Appendix A ) and the optimization-based baselines need it for their source statistics; no target data, labels, or gradients are involved.
blocks.zh: QuAR每批单个前传、0个试验时间更新模型或量子参数,以及没有储存过去的样品。 它唯一的状态是运行目标时刻(Appendix Q Q)的大约170 170 KB(峰值内存的0.01%);它是无后推力的,每重排活化一次会增加一乘-加. 一次前传就足够了,因为每次校正都只取决于通过自身接口的内容. 目标是固定的,因为校正给出了源点瞬间,而输入-侧统计是被钩子所看到的活化的活化的运行时刻. 因此,钩子纠正了活化,更新了普通前方内部的任何时刻,在任何深度,输出时没有任何评价,也没有搜索方向. 这让QuAR在中间分数器之前在一个单行道中行动. FOA,ZOA和FOZO相反,针对需要运行候选者网络的损失调整了几个参数,其衍生的无线估计在每次发布最便宜的配置中要进行两次这样的运行;NEO和T3A是单向的,因为它们也是封闭的形态,但只在头部行动. 出处统计 (μ s, σ s) (\bm{\ mmu s} s} s} s},\bm{\ sig sig s}_{ s} s} s} s} s} s} s} s}) 在测试时没有添加. 一种前钩会把它们积累一次,离线, 超过无标签的清洁源图像, 然后它们与模型一起航行。 PTQ校正已经假定访问(Appendix A)和基于优化的基线需要它来进行源统计;没有涉及目标数据,标签或梯度.

blocks.en: 3.5 Analysis of the quantization-specific loss
blocks.zh: 3.5 具体量化损失分析

blocks.en:
We analyze, to first order,

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Unless noted, all experiments use a quantized ImageNet-trained ViT-B on ImageNet-C ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) at severity 5, all 15 corruptions, the RobustBench ( Croce et al., 2021 ) 5k subset, batch size 64, with episodic reset between corruptions, on an NVIDIA TITAN RTX ( 24 24 GB). We quantize with PTQ4ViT ( Yuan et al., 2022 ) at W6A6/W8A8 and AdaLog ( Wu et al., 2024 ) at W4A4/W3A3. We compare against T3A ( Iwasawa and Matsuo, 2021 ) , FOA ( Niu et al., 2024 ) , ZOA ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , NEO ( Murphy et al., 2026 ) , and FOZO ( Wang and Wang, 2026 ) , the backprop-free methods that run on the frozen quantized graph. Accuracy is the 15-corruption mean top-1, with 3-seed mean ± \pm std (seeds 0 / 1 / 2 0/1/2 ) for the main comparisons, the scope and sensitivity ablations, and the code-distribution diagnostics. The remaining protocol detail is in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.1 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en: QuAR attains the best mean accuracy at every bit-width (Table 1 ), with margins over the strongest baseline from + 2.28 +2.28 at W8A8 to + 4.00 +4.00 at W3A3, against a seed standard deviation of at most 0.14 0.14 for either method. QuAR at W8A8 also exceeds the unadapted full-precision accuracy under corruption, and at W6A6 comes within 1.2 1.2 points of it. The ranking is not an artifact of the corruption mean, the evaluation subset, the quantizer, or symmetric bit-widths. QuAR wins the majority of the 15 individual corruptions and keeps its lead on the full 50 50 k ImageNet-C evaluation (Appendix B ), under the alternative PTQ method wherever that quantizer yields a usable model (Appendix N ), and at asymmetric W4A8, where the margin is + 2.01 +2.01 (Appendix O ).
blocks.zh: QuAR在每个位宽得到最优平均精度(表1),最强基线的比值从W8A8的+2.28+2.28到W3A3的+4.00+4.00,而两种方法的种子标准差最多为0.140.14。 W8A8的QuAR也超过了腐败下未适应的全精度精确度,而W6A6则在其1.2分以内. 排名不是腐败的文物,评价子集,分数器,或者对称的比特宽. QuAR赢得了15个个人腐败中的多数,并保持其在50k图像网-C的全部评价(附录B)上的领先地位,无论哪一个量子产生一个可用的模型(附录N),在非对称的W4A8,其比值为+ 2.01 + 2.01(附录O),都采用替代的PTQ方法.

blocks.en: It reaches that accuracy at single-forward cost and without writing a parameter, at least 46 % 46\% less latency than the two-forward FOA/FOZO/ZOA, which also write 2.3 2.3 K to 25 25 K parameters per batch (Appendix Q ). That comparison reports the optimization-based baselines at their minimum-forward setting; FOA at its recommended population ( K = 28 K{=}28 ) costs far more forwards and still stays below QuAR at every bit-width (Appendix I ). We also measured cost on a Jetson Orin Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , where QuAR runs at 1.071 × 1.071\times the No Adapt latency (Appendix R ). NEO shares that single-forward cost but trails QuAR by 3.00 3.00 points at W6A6.

blocks.en: 4.2 Continual and non-i.i.d. streams

blocks.en: QuAR recalibrates against fixed source statistics, so it does not drift over long streams (Appendix U , Proposition U.3 ). Over a 10-round × \times 15-corruption ImageNet-C stream with state carried throughout (Table 2 ), QuAR is best in every round at both bit-widths and stays essentially flat, 35.6 35.6 – 35.8 35.8 and 53.9 53.9 – 54.0 54.0 . The comparison is against ZOA, the optimization-based quantized-TTA method with a domain memory across segments, and NEO-Continual, the concurrent NEO’s EMA variant at the matched forgetting rate. QuAR beats ZOA by + 3.73 +3.73 at W3A3 against + 1.19 +1.19 at W6A6, on one forward against two, so the margin grows as precision falls, and clears NEO-Continual by + 4.00 +4.00 and + 2.77 +2.77 ; that a final-only recentering trails ZOA at both bit-widths says the forgetting rate does not close the gap; the advantage is the local pre-quant branch.

Under the non-i.i.d. setting, consecutive test batches are dominated by only a few classes. Following SAR ( Niu et al., 2023 ) , we organize the full ImageNet-C test stream using the class-imbalance ratio q max / q min q_{\max}/q_{\min} , where q max q_{\max} and q min q_{\min} denote the maximum and minimum class sampling probabilities.
We sweep it from 1 1 to 5 × 10 5 5{\times}10^{5} , where 10 3 10^{3} gives the dominant class ∼ 50 % {\sim}50\% of each batch (sampler in Appendix A ). QuAR is the most accurate at every imbalance ratio (Appendix K ; Table 24 and Figure 5 ), leading by 1.7 1.7 – 2.7 2.7 points while remaining stable ( 54.55 → 54.73 54.55{\to}54.73 ). This stability follows from its forgetting-free cumulative estimator, whose running mean equals the pooled stream mean and is asymptotically invariant to class order. Other baselines degrade under strong shift (e.g., ZOA by 0.8 0.8 points), while NEO is similarly stable but 3.5 3.5 points less accurate.

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis at the intermediate quantizer inputs
blocks.zh: 4.4 中间量子投入的分析

blocks.en: At the 16 interfaces the local branch acts on (blocks 8–11 × \times {qkv, proj, fc1, fc2}, W6A6), the combined per-channel source–target mismatch under No Adapt is 0.347 0.347 (Appendix P ). Local-only and Ours reduce it to 0.153 0.153 ( − 56.0 % -56.0\% ), whereas Global-only and NEO, acting downstream at the final CLS, reduce it by 0 % 0\% . Saturation stays negligible at ≤ 0.1 % \leq 0.1\% , so the gain comes from a restored distribution rather than reduced clipping (Appendix U ).
blocks.zh: 在16个接口中,本地分支在(blocks 8–11 ×\times {qkv, proj, fc1, fc2} , W6A6),在"不适应"(No Adaption)下,每个通道源-目标组合错配为0.347 0.347 (Appendix P.). 只有本地和我们的系统将其减少到0.153 0.153(−56.0%-56.0\%),而只有Global和近地物体在最后CLS下游运行,将其减少0%-0\%。 饱和度在 ^ 0.1%\leq 0.1 + 时仍然可以忽略不计,所以收益来自于恢复的分布而不是减少剪接(Appendix U.

blocks.en: Position is decisive (Table 5 ). Applying the same four-block, all-module recalibration to the early or middle blocks collapses accuracy to 32.12 32.12 and 43.29 43.29 at W6A6, below No Adapt at 47.68 47.68 , whereas the late blocks (8–11) reach 53.42 53.42 , and the other three bit-widths agree (Appendix F ). This is the empirical counterpart of the late-blocks argument in Section 3.5 . Along the depth axis, accuracy rises up to four trailing blocks and then plateaus, so we fix the smallest scope on it; extending to all twelve blocks collapses accuracy again, to 31.93 31.93 at W6A6. Along the module axis, each interface contributes, post-GELU mlp.fc2 adding + 1.56 +1.56 at W6A6 (Appendix F ). Placement relative to the quantizer is the distinguishing choice: the same correction after the quantizer, or at the block outputs where normalization-statistics adaptation acts, recovers only about half the gain (Appendix P ).
blocks.zh: 立场是决定性的(表5)。 应用相同的四块,将所有模块重排到早期或中间的倒塌的精度为32.12 32.12和43.29 43.29,在W6A6下方为47.68 47.68;而后期的区块(8-11)为53.42 53.42;其他三个位宽同意(附录F)。 这是第3.5节中“后街区”论点的经验对应。 沿着深度轴上,精度上升至四个后接地块再高地,因此我们固定了上面最小的范围;再扩展到所有十二个地块倒塌的精度,到W6A6的31.93 31.93. 在模块轴上,每个接口都会出力,后GELU mlp.fc2在W6A6上加上+1.56+1.56 (Appendix F.). 相对于分数器的放置是区别选择:在分数器之后的同一种修正,或者在正常化-统计适应作用的区块输出时,只回收大约一半的收益(附录P.).

blocks.en: 4.5 Hyperparameter sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4.5 超参数灵敏度

blocks.en: QuAR has one tuned hyperparameter, the recalibration strength λ \lambda of Equation 1 ; the cumulative moment estimator is parameter-free. We select λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 once, on the ViT-B W6A6 sweep of Table 7 , and reuse it unchanged at every other bit-width, backbone and dataset; the baselines keep their published configurations (Appendix A ). Accuracy is insensitive to the choice: every λ \lambda from 0.1 0.1 to 1.0 1.0 beats the best baseline, it moves within 0.2 0.2 points across λ ∈ [ 0.5 , 0.7 ] \lambda\in[0.5,0.7] and across batch sizes 1 1 to 128 128 , and even 8 8 clean calibration batches come within 1.5 1.5 points of the default (Appendix C ). The value also carries across backbones: ViT-B and DeiT-B peak at 0.5 0.5 , ViT-S at 0.3 0.3 (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 4.6 Comparison to backprop-based TTA
blocks.zh: 4.6 与基于后推的TTA的比较

blocks.en: The methods in Table 1 run on the frozen quantized graph directly. Backprop-based TTA instead needs a gradient through it, which the deployed integer kernels do not provide; we supply one with a straight-through estimator and run TENT ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , EATA ( Niu et al., 2022 ) , SAR ( Niu et al., 2023 ) and SPA ( Niu et al., 2025 ) at W6A6 (Table 7 , Appendix S ). None of the three lightweight methods reaches QuAR. SPA does reach a higher top-1, but not at the highest imbalance of Section 4.2 , where it scores 52.63 ± 4.24 52.63{\pm}4.24 against QuAR’s 54.73 ± 0.07 54.73{\pm}0.07 (Appendix L ). It also pays for that top-1 with three forward passes, a backward pass and a full-precision predictor per batch: 5.2 × 5.2\times the latency and 14.6 × 14.6\times the inference memory, 23 23 GB. QuAR adds only 0.17 0.17 MB at 1.10 × 1.10\times the latency, whereas the three lightweight ones need 9.2 9.2 GB at 1.9 1.9 to 3.7 × 3.7\times (Appendix Q ). We also ran the four on the Orin Nano, where each ran out of memory in our harness, so none runs there and QuAR is the most accurate method that does (Appendix R ).

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和结论

blocks.en: The strength λ \lambda is chosen once, not per backbone, which costs up to 0.2 0.2 points on the transformers (Section 4.3 ). The per-channel shift does not fold into a per-tensor quantizer, so the deployable form is an explicit Mul / Add wrapper, which an ONNX Runtime check confirms is representable in standard operators (Appendix T ). We have not implemented QuAR down to an integer-kernel deployment, so its latency, memory, and energy on such a stack are left to future work. On clean source data top-1 changes by at most 0.42 0.42 points across W3A3–W8A8 (Appendix M ), so the correction is safe but inert when adaptation is unnecessary.

We presented QuAR, a single-pass test-time adaptation method for quantized vision transformers that recalibrates activations at the inputs to its frozen quantizers toward source calibration statistics. Across W3A3–W8A8 on ImageNet-C it is the most accurate backprop-free method at low test-time cost, its two branches are complementary, and one fixed configuration carries to continual streams, label shift, out-of-distribution suites, and other backbones.
Our analysis identifies a quantizer-aligned activation-recalibration principle: correcting activation moments at frozen quantizer inputs becomes increasingly valuable as precision falls and the grid forfeits code resolution.
For quantized deployment, much of the accessible test-time accuracy is recoverable without any gradient, extra forward pass, parameter update, or stored data.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了QuAR, 一种单通测试时间调整方法, 用于量化的视变器, 重新校正其被冻结的量子输入时的活性, 用于源校正统计。 在ImageNet-C上的W3A3-W8A8上,这是最准确的无背丙方法,其两个分支互为补充,一个固定配置带入了连续的溪流、标签转换、分配外套房和其他骨干。
我们的分析确定了一个量子-相配活化-再校正原则:随着精度下降和电网丧失了代码分辨率,在被冻结的量子输入时纠正活化瞬间变得越来越有价值。
对于量化的部署,许多可获取的测试时间精度是可以恢复的,没有梯度、额外前行通道、参数更新或存储数据。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work uses only publicly available benchmarks and publicly released model checkpoints. It involves no human subjects, collects no new data, and introduces no dataset. The contribution is methodological; it inherits the known biases and limitations of the models and datasets it is applied to, and neither adds to nor removes them. Test-time adaptation of a quantized model lowers the cost of running vision classifiers on edge hardware; we see no application-specific risk beyond those of the underlying classifiers, and no ethical concern beyond those general to machine learning research on public benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 这项工作只使用公开的基准和公开发布的示范检查站。 它没有涉及人类主体,没有收集新的数据,也没有引入数据集。 这种贡献是方法性的;它继承了它所应用的模型和数据集的已知偏差和局限性,既不增加也不去除它们。 对定量模型的试验时间调整降低了在边缘硬件上运行视觉分级器的成本;我们看到除了基本的分级器之外没有特定的应用风险,除了一般的机器学习公共基准研究之外,没有道德问题。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: Every number reported in the paper follows the protocol of Appendix A , which states the quantized checkpoints and calibration recipe, how the source per-channel moments are accumulated, the evaluation protocol, the seed protocol, and the hardware. QuAR runs one configuration everywhere: local scope blocks 8–11 × \times {qkv, proj, fc1, fc2}, λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 , the cumulative moment estimate ( α = 0.1 \alpha{=}0.1 EMA for the continual setting only), clip ratio ρ = 3 \rho{=}3 and ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon{=}10^{-6} ; none of these is tuned per dataset, bit-width, or backbone. QuAR itself is deterministic given the test stream: the seeds 0 / 1 / 2 0/1/2 of the three-seed tables vary only the stream order and the internal randomness of the optimization-based baselines, while the quantized checkpoint and its calibration are fixed at seed 0 0 .

blocks.en: We quantize with PTQ4ViT ( Yuan et al., 2022 ) for W6A6/W8A8 and AdaLog ( Wu et al., 2024 ) for W4A4/W3A3, following the quantization protocol of ZOA ( Deng et al., 2025 ) and FOZO ( Wang and Wang, 2026 ) , and with AdaLog for the asymmetric W4A8 setting of Appendix O . The source moments are accumulated in one pass over 12,800 12{,}800 unlabeled clean source images (Appendix A ), so no target data, labels or gradients are used. The CIFAR- and DomainNet-fine-tuned models of Appendix H follow the same recipe, with calibration and source moments drawn from their own training splits.

blocks.en: Appendix A Experimental and reproducibility details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实验性和可复制性细节

blocks.en: Model and quantization. All experiments use ViT-B/16 from timm ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) unless noted. W6A6 and W8A8 use PTQ4ViT ( Yuan et al., 2022 ) with Hessian-guided calibration on 32 32 calibration images; W3A3 and W4A4 use AdaLog ( Wu et al., 2024 ) checkpoints. Weights and activation quantizers are frozen at test time. For the backbone study (Appendix D ), DeiT-B/16 and ViT-S/16 are freshly PTQ4ViT-quantized at W6A6 with the same recipe. The benchmarks beyond ImageNet (Appendix H ) use ViT-B/16 backbones fine-tuned on their own source data, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and DomainNet’s real domain, and quantized with this same recipe at all four bit-widths.

blocks.en: Source statistics. The source per-channel moments ( μ s , σ s ) (\mu_{s},\sigma_{s}) at the 16 16 local interfaces and at the CLS position are accumulated in a single pass over 200 200 batches of 64 64 ( ≈ 12,800 \approx 12{,}800 clean, uncorrupted ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) validation images, the split from which the FOA, FOZO and ZOA source statistics are also computed under their published protocol, which uses the full set). No corrupted or labeled data are used. For CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C and DomainNet-126 the same single pass runs on the training split of the corresponding source dataset, so no test or target image is seen.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. ImageNet-C uses the RobustBench ( Croce et al., 2021 ) 5,000 5{,}000 -image test subset at severity 5 5 over all 15 15 corruptions, batch size 64 64 . Following standard TTA practice, the source artifact is held fixed (the PTQ-quantized checkpoint and its source calibration statistics, calibrated once at seed 0); for the three-seed tables, seeds 0 / 1 / 2 0/1/2 vary the online test-stream order and, for the optimization-based methods, their internal randomness (FOA’s CMA-ES sampling, FOZO’s and ZOA’s zeroth-order perturbations). The reported standard deviations therefore capture each method’s online-adaptation variance: it is within 0.01 0.01 for No Adapt and small for the closed-form methods (T3A, NEO, and QuAR, which carry no internal randomness and depend on the stream only through their running statistics), while reflecting optimization noise for FOA/FOZO/ZOA. Because every method is evaluated on this identical fixed checkpoint, any one-time PTQ-calibration variance is common to all and does not change their relative ranking. Each corruption is adapted episodically (state reset between corruptions) except in the continual setting (Section 4.2 ), where the running moments are reset only once at the start of the 10 10 -round stream. ImageNet-R uses its 200 200 -class subset; ImageNet-Sketch uses all 1,000 1{,}000 classes. CIFAR-10-C and CIFAR-100-C use the full 10,000 10{,}000 images per corruption over the same 15 15 corruptions at severity 5 5 , with each 32 × 32 32\times 32 image resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 ; DomainNet-126 uses the three target domains in full and resets between domains, with Resize ( 256 ) (256) and CenterCrop ( 224 ) (224) on both source and target images.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 ImageNet-C使用Robust Bench (Croce等, 2021年) 5000 5{,}000-图像测试子集,在严重性为5 5. 在所有15起腐败中,批量大小为64 64. 遵循标准的TTA惯例,源出文物被固定(PTQ-定量检查点及其源出校正统计,一次在种子上校正;对于三种子表,种子0/ 1/ 2 0/1/2 改变在线测试流程顺序,而对于优化方法,其内部随机性(FOA的CMA-ES取样,FOZO和ZOA的零序扰动). 因此,所报告的标准偏差反映了每种方法的在线适应差异:不适应方法在0.01 0.01以内,封闭式方法(T3A、近地物体和QuAR)小,它们没有内部随机性,仅通过运行的统计依赖于流出),同时反映了FOA/FOZO/ZOA的优化噪音。 因为每一种方法都在这个相同的固定检查站上被评价,所以任何一次性的PTQ-校正差异都是大家共有的,不会改变他们的相对排名. 每一起腐败都经过了典型的调整(在腐败之间重设状态),除非在持续环境下(第4.2节),运行时刻只在10个10个轮流开始时重设一次。 ImageNet-R使用它的200-200类子集;ImageNet-Sketch使用所有的1000 1{,}000类. We use one configuration throughout: local scope blocks 8–11 × \times {qkv, proj, fc1, fc2} and the post-LN CLS position; local recalibration strength λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 (the global CLS branch uses the full recalibration, λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 ); a forgetting-free cumulative running moment estimate by default (a forgetting EMA at rate α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 for the continual setting only); clip ratio ρ = 3 \rho=3 ; ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} . blocks.en: Table 7 sweeps the recalibration strength λ \lambda , the test batch size, and the source-moment set size at W6A6 (B3 scope, ImageNet-C, 3-seed 0/1/2, episodic), all with the default forgetting-free cumulative moment estimate; Table 11 repeats the sweep with per-cell standard deviations. Because that estimate averages moments over all batches seen and never forgets, the method is essentially batch-size invariant : accuracy stays within 0.2 0.2 points across every batch size from 1 1 to 128 128 ( 54.27 54.27 at 1 1 , 54.47 54.47 at 8 8 , 54.35 54.35 at 64 64 , 54.29 54.29 at 128 128 ), so it does not collapse at small batches the way a noisier per-batch or fixed-rate estimate would. Even at batch size 1 1 the local per-channel moments are still taken over the N N tokens of the single image, so σ t ℓ \sigma_{t}^{\ell} remains well-defined; only the CLS branch sees a single token per image there, and its variance ratio is kept finite by the clamp (Section 3 ). The frozen source moments ( 𝝁 s , 𝝈 s ) (\bm{\mu}_{s},\bm{\sigma}_{s}) are estimated once, offline, from clean source batches, and accuracy depends only weakly on how many once there are a few hundred images; with 8 8 batches ( 512 512 images) it is 52.90 52.90 , within about 1.5 1.5 points of the default, and it saturates near the default level from 64 64 batches onward ( 54.18 54.18 at 64 64 , 54.29 54.29 at 128 128 , 54.33 54.33 at 256 256 ). The moments do not depend on the evaluation split either, since the same 12,800 12{,}800 images drawn from the training set give 54.14 54.14 , matching the validation-set default to within 0.2 0.2 points. The variance-ratio clamp ρ \rho is a stability rail rather than a tuned knob: sweeping ρ ∈ { 2 , 3 , 5 , ∞ } \rho\in\{2,3,5,\infty\} (the last removes the clamp) moves mean accuracy monotonically over a 0.5 0.5 -point range ( 54.05 / 54.37 / 54.45 / 54.54 54.05/54.37/54.45/54.54 ), so the default ρ = 3 \rho{=}3 gives up at most 0.2 0.2 points relative to no clamp while still bounding the applied affine gain over long continual streams (Proposition U.3 ). This benign-regime cost is repaid exactly where the clamp is meant to act. At the deployed batch size the per-channel target variance is well estimated and the clamp rarely binds; but when the per-batch token count is small or the stream is strongly class-concentrated, individual channels collapse toward a constant ( σ t , c → 0 \sigma_{t,c}\!\to\!0 ) and the unclamped ratio σ s , c / σ t , c \sigma_{s,c}/\sigma_{t,c} diverges. Sweeping batch size and stream order under the cumulative estimator makes the crossover explicit (Table 12 ): removing the clamp changes accuracy by at most 0.2 0.2 points at batch sizes 64 64 down to 4 4 , but costs 1.0 1.0 point at batch size 1 1 on an i.i.d. stream and 1.6 1.6 points at batch size 1 1 under a class-sorted (online-label-shift) stream. The batch-size invariance reported above relies on the clamp at the smallest batches: without it, batch- 1 1 accuracy falls from 54.31 54.31 to 53.29 53.29 . The clamp is therefore not free on the development benchmark, but it is what keeps the recalibration safe at small batch, under label shift, and over long continual streams.

blocks.en:
The target moments in Equation 2 are a running average of the
per-batch moments: its running mean equals the pooled mean over all tokens, while its running standard deviation averages the per-batch standard deviations. A natural alternative is a streaming Welford estimate, which tracks running raw moments and gives the exact pooled variance over all tokens seen (including the between-batch component). Table 13 swaps the deployed estimator for this alternative in the local branch, the global branch, or both, at batch sizes 64 64 and 1 1 . All four variants fall within about 0.15 0.15 points of one another; at batch size 64 64 they are statistically tied (spread 0.02 0.02 , per-cell std ∼ 0.02 {\sim}0.02 ), and at batch size 1 1 the deployed estimator is the best. The estimator is therefore not a sensitive knob: the local branch already pools B ⋅ N B\!\cdot\!N tokens, so its per-channel statistics are well estimated even at batch size 1 1 , and the variance-ratio clamp bounds the only branch (CLS) whose per-batch estimate can degenerate at batch size 1 1 . Since the exact pooled (Welford) estimate offers no empirical advantage, we adopt the simpler running form; it additionally covers both the cumulative (stationary) and EMA (continual) regimes with a single update, whereas a streaming Welford variance would fall back to the exponentially weighted form under drift, which conflates the moving mean with the spread.

blocks.en: Equation 2 pools the per-channel moments across the batches of a domain. A local interface could instead be corrected with the moments of the batch at hand, at no cost in forward passes, since the hook sees the whole batch before it corrects. This is a different question from when each branch updates (below), where the current batch joins the running average rather than replacing it. Table 14 answers it on both sides, varying the local branch only and leaving the global branch at its deployed setting. Correcting the local interfaces with the current batch’s own moments costs 2.0 2.0 points at batch size 64 64 and 16.2 16.2 at batch size 1 1 , and under label shift a class-dominated batch normalizes itself, falling to 42.39 42.39 and 23.89 23.89 at imbalance 10 3 10^{3} and 5 × 10 5 5{\times}10^{5} ; re-selecting λ \lambda for that estimator recovers little ( 52.76 52.76 at λ = 0.25 \lambda{=}0.25 ), and a full match of those moments is worse still ( 48.85 48.85 at λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 ). Pooling across batches averages the per-channel noise down and keeps the correction a fixed map that the batch composition cannot move. In the other direction, fixing the moments at the values they converge to over a full extra pass through the same stream stays within 0.3 0.3 points of the deployed estimate at every setting, and is below it under the strongest label shift. Moment quality is therefore not what limits accuracy.

blocks.en: The two branches differ in when they update their running moments, for the same positional reason that lets the global branch match fully (Section 3 ): what lies downstream of each correction. The CLS representation is terminal, consumed only by the linear head, so an error in its running moments becomes one per-dimension affine map of the CLS features shared by every sample in the batch, hence a fixed linear distortion of the head plus a class-prior offset, and no later layer compounds it; empirically the global branch is insensitive to it (the global-lagged row of Table 15 is within 0.04 0.04 of the deployed design on the full stream and at batch size 1, and within 0.16 0.16 under label shift). The global branch therefore updates first and corrects with moments that include the current batch: the correction is informative from the very first batch of a domain. A local interface instead feeds the remaining blocks and quantizers, which carry a statistics error to the logits with the downstream gain K > ℓ K_{>\ell} (Corollary U.1 ) and do so differently for every token, so a class-skewed batch fed into its own moments would distort its own predictions. The local branch therefore corrects with the moments of the preceding batches and updates afterwards. Table 15 confirms both halves: making the global branch lag costs 2.60 2.60 points on the first batch, making the local branch inclusive costs 0.84 0.84 and 2.85 2.85 points under label shift, and at convergence the three designs agree within 0.04 0.04 . The cost is a one-batch warm-up: on the first batch of a domain only the global branch acts, and after five batches accuracy is within about one point of the full-stream value.

blocks.en: To test generality beyond ViT-B, we apply QuAR to two further backbones at W6A6, DeiT-B and ViT-S, each freshly quantized with PTQ4ViT (their clean W6A6 accuracy is within 3 3 – 4 4 points of full precision, comparable to ViT-B). Table 4 compares against every baseline of Table 1 . With the same configuration as the main experiments ( λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 ), QuAR is the best method on all three backbones, and seed-stable (per-backbone std ≤ 0.06 \leq 0.06 , against up to 0.07 0.07 for FOA and 0.65 0.65 for FOZO). This is where the partial recalibration matters: the full match ( λ = 1 \lambda=1 ) over-corrects the per-channel scale on these backbones, most visibly on the noise corruptions, and the local branch then fails to help; the gentler λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 recovers a consistent gain (Figure 4 ; e.g. ViT-S 35.55 → 38.29 35.55\to 38.29 at seed 0 0 , ahead of NEO by + 2.2 +2.2 in Table 4 ) while being neutral-to-better on ViT-B. The local recalibration thus transfers across backbones once its strength is moderated.

blocks.en: Appendix E Applying QuAR to a convolutional backbone (CNN)
blocks.zh: 附录E 将 QuAR 应用到革命骨干(CNN)

blocks.en: This paper targets quantized ViTs, but QuAR is defined at a frozen activation quantizer rather than at anything specific to a transformer, so it should carry over to a convolutional network. The premise carries over first. A frozen activation quantizer has its range fixed to the source distribution, a test-time shift moves the per-channel activations within that range, and the network’s own normalization does not undo it, since GroupNorm acts within each sample across channel groups whereas the drift that mis-ranges the quantizer is per channel across the batch. The two act along different axes, exactly as Section 3 argues for LayerNorm and tokens. Both branches then carry over by naming the convolutional counterparts of the tensors they precede: the local branch recalibrates the activations entering the quantizers of the last stage ( layer4 , 8 activation quantizers here), and the global branch recalibrates the pooled feature entering the classifier, the analogue of the CLS representation at the head input. Per-channel statistics are reduced over batch, height and width, the conv counterpart of the reduction over batch and tokens, and we transfer the placement rule of Section F , recalibrate the last stage, rather than re-deriving a scope here.
blocks.zh: 本文针对的是被量化的ViTs,但QuAR在被冻结的活化量子中被定义,而不是在任何特定于变压器上被定义,因此它应该被结转到一个革命网络上. 前提先过. 一个被冻结的活化量子被固定到源位分布,一个测试时位移将每个通道的活化量移到这个范围内,而且网络本身的常态化并不能解除它,因为GroupNorm在每一个样本中作用于跨通道组,而错位的活化量子被移动到每个分批通道. 这两起事件是沿着不同的轴线进行的,完全如第3节为LayerNorm和道具所主张的那样. 两个分支继而命名了它们之前的对数器的同位素:局部分支重新校正了进入末级的等分数器(层4,8活化等分数器在此)的活化器,而全球分支则重新校正了集合特性入分数器,CLS代表符在头输入的相仿. 每道统计在分批量,高地和宽地上被削减,在分批量和地物上被削减的相接方,我们转移了F节的放入规则,重新调整了最后阶段,而不是在这里重新划定一个范围.

blocks.en: We use the ResNet-50 variant that prior test-time adaptation work evaluates on ( Niu et al., 2023 ; Niu et al., 2024 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) (timm resnet50_gn , which normalizes with GroupNorm). PTQ4ViT is designed for transformers, so we quantize with MQBench ( Li et al., 2021 ) , the standard post-training quantization toolkit for convolutional networks, at W6A6 on its Academic backend with 32 calibration batches and its default observers. MQBench inserts each activation quantizer as its own module, so QuAR attaches to precisely the tensor entering a frozen quantizer, with no change to the quantizer itself. The quantized model reaches 79.44 79.44 clean top-1 against 80.25 80.25 in full precision.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ResNet-50的变体,先前的试验时间适应工作对(Niu等人,2023年;Niu等人,2024年;Niu等人,2025年)进行评估(Timm renet50_gn,与GroupNorm实现正常化)。 PTQ4ViT是针对变压器设计的,因此我们用MQ Bench(Li等,2021年),即用于演化网络的标准的训练后量子化工具包进行量化,位于其学术后端的W6A6上,有32个校正批次并默认观察者. MQ Bench将每个活化量子作为自己的模块来插入,因此QuAR将精确地附着在进入被冻结的量子上,没有改变量子本身. 被量化的型号完全精确地达到了79.44 79.44 干净的顶级-1对80.25 80.25.

blocks.en: The recalibration strength transfers in form but not in value. Sweeping it over the same corruptions (seed 0) gives 33.86 33.86 , 33.91 \mathbf{33.91} , 32.67 32.67 , 31.38 31.38 , 28.59 28.59 and 26.54 26.54 at λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , 0.25 0.25 , 0.4 0.4 , 0.5 0.5 , 0.75 0.75 and 1.0 1.0 , so the curve is single-peaked with its optimum at 0.25 0.25 , where a 3-seed run reaches 33.91 ± 0.01 33.91_{\,\pm 0.01} , a gain of 3.79 3.79 points. This continues the trend already visible across transformers, where ViT-B peaks at 0.5 0.5 while the smaller ViT-S and distilled DeiT-B peak at 0.3 0.3 (Section 4.5 ). A full match stays harmful, λ = 1 \lambda=1 falling to 26.54 26.54 , which is 3.58 3.58 below No Adapt and is the shrinkage effect of Proposition U.2 appearing again away from transformers. The component structure reproduces as well: at λ = 0.25 \lambda=0.25 the global branch alone reaches 32.66 32.66 , the local branch alone 33.25 ± 0.06 33.25_{\,\pm 0.06} , and the two together 33.91 ± 0.01 33.91_{\,\pm 0.01} , so both branches contribute, the local branch is the larger driver, and the combination is best, which is the pattern of the ViT ablation in Section 4.1 . What carries over is therefore not only the sign of the gain but the shape of the method.
blocks.zh: 重新校正强度以形式转移,但不以价值转移. 在同一种腐败(种子为0)上擦去后得到33.86 33.86, 33.91\ mathbf{33.91}, 32.67 32.67, 31.38 31.38, 28.59 28.59和26.54 26.54, 在 = = 0.1\lambda=0.1, 0.25 0.25, 0.4 0.4, 0.5 0.5, 0.75 0.75 和 1.0 1.0, 曲线以 0.25 0.25 的优异成绩单峰, 其中 三种子跑跑达到 33.91 ± 0.01 33.91 = pm 0.01 = 3.79分. 这延续了在变压器中已经显现出的趋势,VIT-B的峰值为0.5;而较小的VIT-S和蒸馏出DeiT-B的峰值为0.3(第4.5节)。 完全匹配仍然有害,QQ=1\lambda=1倒计时为26.54 26.54,即低于"不适应"的3.58 3.58,是Proposition U.2再次从变压器外出产生的收缩效应. 构件结构也复制: = = 0.25\ lambda= 0.25 单是全球分行达到32.66 32.66,单是本地分行达到33.25±0.06 33.25_{\,\pm 0.06},两个分行加起来达到33.91±0.01 33.91_{\,\pm 0.01},所以两个分行都贡献了,本地分行是更大的驱动力,组合是最好的,这是4.1节中VIT衰减的规律. 因此,结转的不仅是收益的标志,而且是方法的形状。

blocks.en: The same configuration applies unchanged to a BatchNorm ResNet-50, where it lifts accuracy from 17.32 17.32 to 24.57 ± 0.06 24.57_{\,\pm 0.06} on the same 15 corruptions. We note this only to show that nothing in the method depends on the normalization layer. A BatchNorm network additionally stores per-channel running statistics, which opens adaptation routes that a GroupNorm backbone does not have and that are outside the scope of this paper. FORGE ( Rehan et al., 2026 ) takes that route on folded integer-only CNNs.
blocks.zh: 同样的配置适用于BatchNorm ResNet-50,它将准确度从17.32 17.32提高到24.57±0.06 24.57_{\,\pm 0.06}在同一15起腐败上。 我们注意到这一点只是为了表明,方法中没有任何东西取决于正常化层面。 一个BatchNorm网络额外存储了每道运行统计,它打开了GroupNorm主干线没有的且不属于本文范围的适应路径. FORGE(Rehan等人,2026年)在折叠的整数只收录有线电视新闻网上取取去这条路线.

blocks.en: Appendix F Recalibration scope
blocks.zh: 附录F 调整范围

blocks.en: The scope ablation in the main text (Table 5 ) is run in the Local-only configuration (no global CLS branch; ImageNet-C severity 5, 15 corruptions, 5k subset, batch size 64, 3-seed (0/1/2), episodic; No Adapt is 47.68 at W6A6 and 47.30 at W4A4); here we give the full reasoning behind it. Four observations drive the scope choice. (i) Recalibrating the full network collapses accuracy (31.93 at W6A6, vs. 53.42 53.42 for the late-block default), because the affine corrections compound block by block; the gain comes from recalibrating only the late blocks. (ii) Within the late-block region accuracy rises with the number of trailing blocks up to four and then plateaus : blocks 8–11 reach 53.42 53.42 , and extending to blocks 7–11, 6–11, or 5–11 does not improve on it (each within 0.15 0.15 points, none exceeding it) before it declines, while each added block recalibrates four more interfaces. We therefore fix the smallest scope on this plateau, blocks 8–11 (16 interfaces): the plateau accuracy at the lowest recalibration overhead. (iii) Including the post-GELU mlp.fc2 interface helps at every bit-width: at the blocks 8–11 default it adds + 1.56 +1.56 (W6A6) and + 1.60 +1.60 (W4A4) over the {qkv, proj, fc1} set (module axis), + 2.33 +2.33 and + 1.10 +1.10 at W3A3 and W8A8 (Table 18 ), and the gain holds at every multi-block depth (Table 17 ). (iv) Recalibration must target the late blocks: applying the same four-block, all-module recalibration to the early (blocks 0–3) or middle (blocks 4–7) blocks collapses accuracy to 32.12 32.12 and 43.29 43.29 , far below No Adapt ( 47.68 47.68 ), whereas the late blocks (8–11) reach 53.42 53.42 . A correction inserted early must propagate through every subsequent quantized layer, which re-quantizes and compounds it (the mechanism behind the all-blocks collapse); a late correction sits just before the head and directly restores the representation the classifier consumes, with few downstream layers to compound through. Corollary U.1 formalizes this: a correction’s residual at interface ℓ \ell reaches the logits scaled by the downstream gain K > ℓ K_{>\ell} , which we measure to fall ∼ 4.4 × {\sim}4.4\times from the early to the late blocks (Figure 6 ). We therefore recalibrate the last four blocks at all four interfaces. We note that mlp.fc2 , whose pre-quant statistics a calibration-reliability check flags as atypical (large dynamic range, most values near a quantizer boundary), is nonetheless beneficial to recalibrate: excluding it, as an earlier four-corruption pilot had suggested, leaves accuracy on the table.
blocks.zh: 主文中的范围缩小(表5)是按仅本地配置运行的(没有全球CLS分支;ImageNet-C严重性5;15个腐败;5k子集;批量大小64;3-种子(0/1/2);史诗;W6A6和W4A4的47.30不适应是47.68;我们在此给出其背后的全部推理. 四种观察能驱动范围选择. (一)调整全网倒塌精度(W6A6时为31.93分,后期区块默认值为53.42 53.42分),因为近缘校正复合区块逐个区块;收益来自仅调整后期区块. (二)后街区区域内的精度会随着后街区数上升而达到四个后高地:区块8-11达到 53.42 53.42,并延伸到区块7-11,6-11,或5-11,在下降前没有改善(每区点0.15分以内,无一超过),而每区块会再调整四个接口. 因此,我们确定这个高地上最小的范围,第8至11个区块(16个接口):高地精确度最低的再校正高地。 (三)包括后GELU mlp.fc2接口在每个位宽处有所帮助:在区块8-11默认值中,在{qkv, proj, fc1} set(模块轴),+ 2.33 + 2.33和+ 1.10 + 1.10的W3A3和W8A8(表18),每个多块深度的增益(表17)上,增加+1.56 +1.56 (W6A6)和+1.60 (W4A4). (四)再调整必须针对后期区块:将相同的4个区块,全单元再调整到早期(区块0-3)或中间(区块4-7)区块倒塌的精度为32.12 32.12和43.29 43.29,远低于"不调整"(47.68 47.68),而后期区块(8-11)达到53.42 53.42. 早期插入的校正必须通过以后的每一个被分解的地层进行传播,这些地层将它重新分解并复合起来(所有地块倒塌背后的机制);晚期的校正就坐在头前并直接恢复分类者所消耗的表示,很少有下游地层可以通过. comrollary U.1将这一点正式化:在接口l\ell中,修正的剩余部分到达由下游增益K > l K_{>\ell}所缩放的对数,我们衡量它从早期到后期(图6)跌倒。 因此,我们调整所有四个接口的最后四个街区。 我们注意到,mlp.fc2作为非典型的校正-可靠性检查旗(大动态范围,大多数数值接近四分位器边界),其前方统计数据仍然有助于重新校正:如前四位腐败问题试点人所建议,排除它会留下准确性。

blocks.en: Appendix G Generalization beyond ImageNet-C: ImageNet-R, Sketch, C ¯ \overline{\mathrm{C}} , and 3DCC
blocks.zh: 附录G 网-C:图像网-R,Sketch,C'\overline\mathrm{C}和3DCC

blocks.en: We evaluate two non-corruption shifts: ImageNet-R ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) (renditions) and ImageNet-Sketch ( Wang et al., 2019 ) . Table 4 reports top-1 accuracy across all bit-widths. QuAR is the best method on ImageNet-Sketch at every bit-width, and it also improves over the no-adaptation baseline on ImageNet-R at every bit-width. On ImageNet-R the recentering baselines edge ahead by a small margin: Ours trails the best method by 0.11 0.11 at W3A3, 0.37 0.37 at W4A4, 0.65 0.65 at W6A6 and 0.40 0.40 at W8A8, while remaining the strongest method overall. The partial recalibration ( λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 ) is what enables this: the full match ( λ = 1 \lambda=1 ) over-corrects the rendition-style per-channel statistics and pushes ImageNet-R below No Adapt, whereas the gentler λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 keeps ImageNet-R above No Adapt at every bit-width while preserving the corruption and sketch gains. Ours therefore no longer trades ImageNet-R for its other gains.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个不腐败的转变: ImageNet-R (Hendrycks等,2021年)(reditions)和ImageNet-Sketch (Wang等,2019年). 表4报告所有位宽的精度最高的1。 QuAR是ImageNet-Sketch上每个位宽的最佳方法,它也比每个位宽的ImageNet-R上的不适应基线有所改进. 在ImageNet-R上, 最近的基线领先一点: 我们在W3A3,0.37 0.37,W4A4,0.65 0.65,W6A6和W8A8,0.40 0.40中以0.11 0.11跟踪了最佳方法,而总体仍然是最强方法。 部分重新校正(QQ = 0.5\lambda= 0.5)是促成这一点的因素: 完全匹配(QQ = 1\lambda= 1) 过度校正了每个频道的递解式统计,将ImageNet-R推向"不适应"以下,而更温和的QQ = 0.5\lambda= 0.5 将ImageNet-R保持在"不适应"之上,同时保留了腐败和草图收益. 因此,我们不再以ImageNet-R换取其他收益。

blocks.en: We further test two corruption benchmarks disjoint from the ImageNet-C corruptions used to choose QuAR’s configuration: ImageNet- C ¯ \overline{\mathrm{C}} ( Mintun et al., 2021 ) (10 algorithmic corruptions designed to be perceptually dissimilar from ImageNet-C) and ImageNet-3DCC ( Kar et al., 2022 ) (12 corruptions synthesized using 3D scene geometry). Both use severity 5 on the 1000-class RobustBench ( Croce et al., 2021 ) 5k subset, batch size 64, episodic, with the same frozen λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 configuration; the combined Table 19 reports 3-seed mean ± \pm std (seeds 0/1/2) for all four benchmarks. QuAR is the best method at every bit-width on both suites: over No Adapt it adds + 5.5 +5.5 to + 7.8 +7.8 on C ¯ \overline{\mathrm{C}} and + 2.8 +2.8 to + 3.4 +3.4 on 3DCC, so the local recalibration restores accuracy even on corruption types it was never tuned on.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步测试两个腐败基准, 图像网- C \ overline\ mathrm{ C } (Mintun等,2021年) (10个算法腐败被设计成能与ImageNet-C在概念上相去甚远)和ImageNet-3DCC(Kar等,2022年) (12个腐败被合成使用3D场景几何). 两者在1000级Robust Bench(Croce等,2021年)上均使用重度5,5k子集,批量尺寸为64,偶发,同为被冻结的QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5配置;综合表19报告3-种子指±\pm std(种子为0/1/2)所有四个基准. QuAR是两套套房上每个位宽的最好方法:在"不适应"上,它会在C'\overline\mathrm{C}}和+2.8+2.8+ 2.8+ 3.4+3.4上增加+ 5.5+5.5+7.8+7.8,在3DCC上,所以即使对于它从未被调取的腐败类型,局部再校正也恢复了准确性.

blocks.en: As a final within-family generalization test, we evaluate the four extra ImageNet-C corruptions absent from the 15 standard corruptions used throughout the paper, hence unseen when QuAR’s scope and λ \lambda were chosen: Gaussian blur, saturate, spatter, and speckle noise (severity 5; same 5k subset, batch size 64, episodic, λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 ). Table 20 reports 3-seed mean ± \pm std. QuAR is again the best method at every bit-width, improving over No Adapt by + 3.3 +3.3 to + 6.7 +6.7 , so the recalibration generalizes to corruption types it never saw during method design.

blocks.en: Appendix H Generalization beyond ImageNet: CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C and DomainNet-126
blocks.zh: 附录H 图像网以外的一般化:CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C和域名网-126

blocks.en: The benchmarks above all derive from ImageNet, so we also evaluate two datasets outside that family: CIFAR-10-C and CIFAR-100-C, which repeat the ImageNet-C corruptions on a different dataset, and DomainNet-126, where the shift is a change of domain rather than a corruption.
blocks.zh: 以上基准来源于ImageNet,因此我们也评价了这个家族以外的两个数据集:CIFAR-10-C和CIFAR-100-C,它们重复了不同数据集上ImageNet-C的腐败;和DomainNet-126,其中的转变是域名的改变而不是腐败.

blocks.en: We repeat the ImageNet-C protocol on CIFAR-10-C and CIFAR-100-C ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) , with ViT-B/16 backbones fine-tuned on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 (the public Hugging Face checkpoints nateraw/vit-base-patch16-224-cifar10 , which NEO also evaluates on, and pkr7098/cifar100-vit-base-patch16-224-in21k ) and images upscaled to 224 × 224 224\times 224 ; the full-precision models reach 98.52 98.52 and 92.61 92.61 clean top-1. Quantization follows the main protocol: PTQ4ViT at W6A6/W8A8 with Hessian-guided calibration on 32 32 training images, AdaLog at W4A4/W3A3 with calibration and block reconstruction on training images, and source moments accumulated over a seeded 12,800 12{,}800 -image training subset ( 200 200 batches of 64 64 , as for ImageNet); the ZOA source statistics are likewise computed on the training split. Evaluation uses the 15 15 standard corruptions at severity 5 5 , the full 10,000 10{,}000 images per corruption, batch 64 64 , episodic reset, and three sample-order seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们重复关于CIFAR-10-C和CIFAR-100-C的ImageNet-C协议(Hendrycks and Dietrich, 2019),ViT-B/16主干线在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上进行了微调(公共Hugging Face检查站 Nateraw/vit-base-patch-16-224-cifar-10),近地天体也在其中进行了评价,pkr7098/cifar-base-patch-base-patch-16-224-in21k)和图像被提升到224×224/224正时;全精度模型达到98.52 98.52和92.61 92.61清高一等. 量化遵循主要协议:PTQ4ViT at W6A6/W8A8,32个训练影像上标有黑森制导校正;AdaLog at W4A4/W3A3,训练影像上标有校正和块状重建;源分集上标有12,800个12{,}800-成像训练子集(200个200个批次,64个64个;ZOA源分集统计同样在训练分集上计算. 评价采用15个15个标准腐败 严重性5 5, 完整的10,000 10{,} 1000个图像 每一个腐败, 第64批 64, 零星重置, 和三个样本顺序种子。

blocks.en: We follow the 126-class protocol of AdaContrast ( Chen et al., 2022 ) on DomainNet ( Peng et al., 2019 ) : the source domain is real and the three target domains are clipart , painting and sketch , each evaluated in full ( 18,523 18{,}523 , 30,042 30{,}042 and 24,147 24{,}147 images). The protocol needs a model trained on the source domain, so we fine-tune one on real alone with a stock recipe: a vit_base_patch16_224.augreg_in21k backbone fine-tuned for five epochs on a seeded 90 % 90\% split (AdamW, learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} , weight decay 0.05 0.05 , 10 % 10\% warm-up then cosine decay, batch 64 64 , label smoothing 0.1 0.1 , mixed precision), reaching 94.28 94.28 top-1 on the held-out 10 % 10\% ; that held-out split also supplies the PTQ calibration data and the source moments. Quantization follows the main protocol, PTQ4ViT at W6A6/W8A8 and AdaLog at W4A4/W3A3, and leaves the clean held-out accuracy at 93.58 93.58 , 93.65 93.65 and 91.41 91.41 at W6A6, W4A4 and W3A3. Adaptation is episodic per target domain, at batch 64 64 and three sample-order seeds. On both benchmarks no test image enters calibration or statistics, QuAR keeps the fixed configuration of the main text, blocks 8–11 at all four interfaces, λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 , cumulative moments, and we run the full baseline set of Table 1 , each in its published configuration. Every method adapts the same frozen quantized checkpoint, so nothing in how that checkpoint was obtained can favour one of them.

blocks.en: Table 21 reports both benchmarks. QuAR is the most accurate method in all twelve dataset × \times bit-width cells, ahead of the runner-up by 0.6 0.6 to 3.7 3.7 points and with a seed std of at most 0.04 0.04 . The runner-up itself changes with the dataset: FOZO on CIFAR-10 at every bit-width and on CIFAR-100 at W4A4/W3A3, ZOA on CIFAR-100 at W6A6/W8A8, and T3A on DomainNet-126 at every bit-width. On CIFAR the gain over No Adapt grows monotonically as precision falls, from + 2.9 +2.9 to + 5.7 +5.7 on CIFAR-10 and from + 3.7 +3.7 to + 6.5 +6.5 on CIFAR-100, the pattern of ImageNet-C, and on DomainNet-126 it grows the same way within each quantizer, from + 2.2 +2.2 to + 4.4 +4.4 under PTQ4ViT and from + 3.6 +3.6 to + 5.3 +5.3 under AdaLog. blocks.en: Appendix J Comparison with Adaptive Quantile Recalibration (AQR)
blocks.zh: 附录J 与可适应量调整(AQR)的比较

blocks.en: AQR ( Mehrbod et al., 2026 ) recalibrates pre-activations in full precision by matching the full channel-wise activation distribution with per-channel quantile transforms at normalization-layer outputs. As no public implementation exists, we implement it in the configuration AQR uses for ViT: after-LayerNorm placement in the top half of the blocks (6–11), 101 101 percentiles, source percentiles estimated from 10,000 10{,}000 training images, and AQR’s paper-default standard tail handling (raw min/max). We report this default configuration rather than a variant tuned on our setting. We first validate the implementation on the full-precision ViT-B, where it improves over No Adapt by + 2.8 +2.8 to + 3.3 +3.3 points at batch sizes ≥ 64 \geq 64 (e.g. 55.58 → 58.42 55.58\to 58.42 at batch 64 64 ), matching the direction reported by Mehrbod et al. (2026) ; AQR’s behavior on the quantized model is therefore a genuine finding, not an implementation artifact.
blocks.zh: AQR (Mehrbod等, 2026年) 完全精准地重新校正了预活性,在正态-水平输出时将全通道的导电活性分布与每个通道的四分位变换相匹配. 由于没有公开执行,我们在对 VIT 的配置 AQR 中执行它: LayerNorm 后置在前半个区块(6–11),101 百分位,来源百分位数估计从10,000 10{,}000 个训练图像,以及 AQR 的纸张默认标准尾端处理(raw min/max)中. 我们报告这种默认配置,而不是根据我们的设置调整的变体。 我们首先验证了在全精度Vit-B上的实施,它比不适应改进了 2.8 + 2.8 到 3.3 + 3.3分,批量尺寸为 ≥ 64\geq 64(例如: 55.58 → 58.42 55.58\to 58.42 第64批),与Mehrbod等人报告的方向相匹配(2026年);因此,量化模型上的AQR行为是真实的发现,而不是执行的产物。

blocks.en: Table 23 compares AQR and QuAR on the quantized W6A6 ViT-B across batch sizes. Even at the large batches AQR is built for ( 64 64 – 512 512 ), where its per-batch quantile estimation is most reliable, QuAR is + 2.0 +2.0 to + 3.0 +3.0 points higher; and, crucial for streaming deployment, AQR’s per-batch quantile estimation is unstable at small batches and collapses at batch size 1 1 ( 18.73 18.73 , below No Adapt, both here and on the full-precision model), whereas QuAR’s source-initialized cumulative statistics keep it robust down to a single image ( 54.27 54.27 ).
blocks.zh: 表23将批量的W6A6 VIT-B的AQR和QuAR进行了比较。 即使是在大批量的AQR建造(64 64 – 512 512),它的每批量估计最可靠,QuAR是+2.0+2.0到+3.0+3.0+3.0分;对于流出部署至关重要,AQR的每批量估计在小批量中不稳定,在批量1(18.73 18.73分以下,不适应)在此处和在全精度模型上都不稳定,而QuAR的来源初始累积统计则将其稳定在一幅图像上(54.27 54.27分)。

blocks.en:
Two design differences explain QuAR’s higher accuracy even in AQR’s favorable large-batch regime. First, QuAR acts at the frozen quantizer and matches the source calibration moments that define its operating point, directly restoring the quantization-specific failure it targets (the distorted code distribution); AQR matches the full activation distribution only at normalization-layer outputs, a quantizer-agnostic correction that is not aligned to the frozen quantizer’s calibrated range.
Second, in this quantized setting, the more effective intervention is to restore the per-channel operating point, mean and scale, at the frozen quantizer input. QuAR does this with stable moment estimates, whereas AQR’s nonlinear per-channel quantile remap is quantizer-agnostic and depends on per-batch percentile estimates, which become unreliable as the batch shrinks.
blocks.zh:
两个设计差异解释了QuAR的更准确性,甚至在AQR的偏好大批量制中也是如此. 首先,QuAR在被冻结的量子上行为,并与定义其运行点的源校正瞬间相匹配,直接恢复它所瞄准的被量化的特异性故障(被扭曲的代码分布); AQR只与正态级输出时的全激活分布相匹配,即一个与被冻结的量子校正范围不相匹配的量子-不可知校正.
其次,在这个被量化的设定中,更有效的干预是在被冻结的量子输入器上恢复每个通道的操作点,平均和规模. QuAR用稳定的瞬间估计来完成这项工作,而AQR的非线性每通道的四分位再映射则具有四分位数-不可知性,并依赖于每分位数的估计,随着批量的收缩,这种估计变得不可靠。

blocks.en: The conclusion is insensitive to AQR’s remaining design choices: varying its placement and scope never lifts it above QuAR (its best configuration, a post-hoc block- 8 8 – 11 11 scope tuned to our setting, still reaches only 52.41 52.41 at batch 64 64 ). Absolute full-precision numbers are not directly comparable to Mehrbod et al. (2026) (whose ViT is trained differently), so we use the full-precision result only as a correctness check.
blocks.zh: 该结论对AQR的其余设计选择不敏感:改变其位置和范围从未将其提升到QuAR(其最佳配置,后热区块 -- -- 8 8 -- -- 11 11 个范围调整到我们的设定,在64 64 批次中仍仅达到 52.41 52.41 个)。 绝对全精度数字与Mehrbod等(2026年)(他们的VIT训练不同)并不直接相媲美,因此我们只使用全精度结果作为正确性检查.

blocks.en: The spread is the more informative half. At this ratio every method in Table 24 stays within 0.35 0.35 of its own mean and QuAR within 0.07 0.07 , whereas SPA varies by more than eight points across seeds on the same stream. The loss concentrates in the blur corruptions, where individual cells fall below 2 2 top-1. Bare SPA optimizes a self-consistency loss between a clean view and two perturbed ones, with no entropy threshold and no redundancy filter, so nothing in it rejects the near-single-class batches this stream produces. Adaptation is reset per corruption, so these collapses occur inside individual corruptions rather than accumulating along the stream.
blocks.zh: 传播是信息较多的一分. 按照这个比率,表24中的每一种方法都保持在0.35 0.35以内,QuAR在0.07 0.07以内,而SPA则在同一溪流的种子之间相差8分以上。 损失集中在模糊的腐败中,其中单个细胞倒数在2 2上到1下. 裸体SPA优化了清取景器和两个扰动景器之间的自相容性损失,没有 en阈值和冗余过滤器,因此其中没有任何东西拒绝这种流产生的近单一级分批. 适应被重置在腐败中,因此这些倒塌发生在个人腐败内部,而不是沿溪而起。

blocks.en: Appendix M Clean source: behavior under no shift
blocks.zh: 附录 M 清洁来源:无转移行为

blocks.en: A test-time method that tracks stream statistics could in principle harm accuracy when there is no shift to correct. We test this directly: we evaluate QuAR in its deployed configuration (local recalibration at blocks 8–11 with λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 , cumulative running target moments, plus the global CLS branch) on clean ImageNet validation (no corruption; the same RobustBench 5k subset, ViT-B, batch size 64, seed 0), the in-distribution match to the clean data on which the source PTQ-calibration moments were collected. Under no shift the running target moments coincide with the frozen source moments, so the recalibration of Equation 1 reduces to the identity up to the finite-sample estimation noise in the running moments (the η \eta of Proposition U.2 ). Table 25 confirms this: across all four bit-widths QuAR changes clean top-1 by at most 0.42 0.42 points (W8A8 − 0.42 -0.42 , W6A6 − 0.08 -0.08 , W4A4 + 0.08 +0.08 , W3A3 − 0.14 -0.14 ). Enabling the recalibration is therefore safe even when adaptation is unnecessary: it neither requires a shift detector nor degrades the in-distribution operating point.

blocks.en: Appendix N Robustness to the quantizer choice
blocks.zh: 附录N 量子选择的强度

blocks.en: The main results follow ZOA’s protocol ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , using AdaLog at W3A3/W4A4 and PTQ4ViT at W6A6/W8A8. To check that QuAR’s gains are not tied to a particular PTQ method, we additionally run both quantizers at every bit-width (Table 26 ; same 15-corruption ImageNet-C protocol, seed 0, episodic; QuAR uses per-quantizer source statistics). Excluding the degenerate PTQ4ViT-at-W3A3 column, where PTQ4ViT collapses to near-chance for all methods (it is not intended for 3-bit, which is exactly why the main protocol uses AdaLog there), QuAR is the best method in all seven remaining quantizer × \times bit-width settings, so the recalibration is quantizer-agnostic. PTQ4ViT at W6A6/W8A8 reproduces the main tables (QuAR 54.35 54.35 at W6A6, 60.44 60.44 at W8A8), confirming the pipeline. Within either quantizer the gain over No Adapt grows monotonically as precision falls, from 5.08 5.08 at W8A8 to 7.63 7.63 at W3A3 under AdaLog and from 6.08 6.08 at W8A8 to 7.47 7.47 at W4A4 under PTQ4ViT; the dip between W6A6 and W4A4 in Figure 1 a is the change of quantizer, not of the mechanism.

PTQ4ViT at W6A6/W8A8复制了主表(QuAR 54.35 54.35 at W6A6, 60.44 60.44 at W8A8),证实了管道. 在任一量子中,随着精度的下降,不适应的增益是单一地增长的,从AdaLog下的5.08 5.08到W3A3的7.63,从PTQ4ViT下的6.08 6.08到W4A4的7.47 7.47;图1a中W6A6和W4A4之间的倾斜是量子的改变,而不是机制的改变。

blocks.en: Appendix O Asymmetric deployment bit-widths
blocks.zh: 附录 O 不对称部署位宽

blocks.en: The bit-widths in the main text are symmetric, but integer inference deploys asymmetric ones. Weights are static and can be quantized per channel, whereas activations are dynamic and the integer kernels of mainstream accelerators are built around 8-bit multiply-accumulate, so the practical combination is aggressive weights with conservative activations. Two formats dominate, W8A8, which the main table already covers, and W4A8, which it does not. We therefore add W4A8 on the same protocol as Table 1 (Table 27 ).
blocks.zh: 主文中的比特-widths是对称的,但整数推论部署的是不对称的. 重量是静态的,每个通道都可以被量化,而活化是动态的,而主流加速器的整数内核是围绕8位乘积而成的,因此实际的组合是带有保守活化的侵略性活化. 两种格式占主导地位,一种是主表已经覆盖的W8A8,另一种是它没有覆盖的W4A8. 因此,我们在与表1相同的议定书上增加了W4A8(表27)。

blocks.en: We quantize it with AdaLog, following the paper’s existing practice of using AdaLog wherever the weights are low-bit. That choice is forced rather than convenient. Measured under one protocol on 10,240 10{,}240 held-out clean images, full precision reaches 85.16 85.16 , PTQ4ViT gives 85.14 85.14 at W8A8 and 83.06 83.06 at W6A6, and AdaLog gives 83.18 83.18 at W4A4 and 85.22 85.22 at W4A8, while PTQ4ViT at W4A8 collapses to 76.62 76.62 . The asymmetric format costs essentially nothing against full precision, which is the reason it is used.
blocks.zh: 我们用AdaLog来量化, 这种选择是强迫的,而不是方便的。 根据10,240 10{,}240 被搁置的清洁图像的一项协议进行测量,全精度达到85.16 85.16,PTQ4ViT在W8A8和83.06 83.06在W6A6中给出85.14 85.14,AdaLog在W4A4和85.22 85.22在W4A8中给出83.18 83.18,而PTQ4ViT在W4A8中给出了76.62 76.62. 非对称格式基本上与完全精确无关,这正是它使用的原因。

The more informative reading is across the columns. Halving the weight bit-width from 8 to 4 moves every one of the seven rows by at most 0.42 0.42 , while dropping the activations from 8 to 4 moves the same rows by six to eight points. blocks.en: The clean-to-corruption accuracy gap of the unadapted model widens monotonically as the model is quantized more aggressively (Table 28 ): full precision loses 28.7 28.7 points from clean ImageNet to ImageNet-C (severity 5), but W3A3 loses 48.4 48.4 . Quantized models are thus markedly more fragile under distribution shift than full-precision ones, consistent with prior reports ( Deng et al., 2025 ) ; this is the regime our method targets. Accuracies are on the same 5000 5000 -image ImageNet / ImageNet-C subset (No Adapt, seed 0 0 ).

Table 29 measures the per-channel source–target mismatch at the late-block input-side recalibration interfaces (blocks 8–11 × \times {qkv, proj, fc1, fc2}, W6A6). The mismatch is the per-channel mean absolute deviation of the target moments from the source calibration moments, averaged over channels; the measured tensor is the activation entering the quantizer (post-recalibration for Local-only/Ours). Local-only and Ours reduce the combined mismatch by 56.0 % 56.0\% , while Global-only and NEO do not reduce it at all, because they act on the final CLS representation downstream of these interfaces. The reduction is partial (not full) because λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 deliberately applies only a partial recalibration, which we find more robust than the full match (Section 3 ). The code-distribution distance reported in Figure 1 b (the − 52 % -52\% restoration) compares the test-time and source quantizer code histograms at all 17 17 recalibration interfaces, averaged over the 15 corruptions and three seeds. The codes are compared as the values they stand for , not as bin indices: each histogram bin is placed at the activation value its code de-quantizes to, and the distance between two histograms is the Wasserstein-1 distance along that value axis, that is, the mass-weighted distance the values move. The histogram at an interface pools its channels and tokens, which is the distribution the per-tensor quantizer actually has: one step serves every channel, so the code distribution is a property of the tensor and not of a channel. That also makes this distance smaller than the per-channel displacement reported in Table 29 , since pooling lets channels that move in opposite directions cancel and D ℓ D_{\ell} is bounded by the channel-average of per-channel distances; the per-channel view is what Table 29 and Table 38 give. The source histograms F ℓ s F^{s}_{\ell} are collected in one pass over the same 12,800 12{,}800 clean ImageNet validation images as the source moments (Appendix A ), and the test histograms over the full 5 5 k stream of each corruption. The diagnostic is run at W6A6, where every interface is uniformly or twin-uniformly quantized; at the AdaLog bit-widths mlp.fc2 is log-quantized and is covered analytically instead (Proposition U.4 ). Comparing values rather than indices is what lets a single metric span the interfaces the method recalibrates, because their code grids are not commensurable. The intermediate interfaces use a symmetric single-scale uniform grid, on which every bin is equally wide, whereas the post-GELU mlp.fc2 interfaces are quantized by a twin uniform quantizer, with a negative step of 0.0053 0.0053 against a positive step of up to 0.9 0.9 . A distance defined on bin indices rather than values would score a change 169 × 169\times smaller identically and would be dominated by the finer sub-grid; on the de-quantized axis every interface is measured in activation units, so none has to be treated separately.
